summary: Iteration 11 frontend E2E for CG Student Portal. Verified all 7 requested flows end-to-end via Playwright (single session run to preserve httpOnly cookies): student rejection-reason visibility, approved-upload state on /dashboard/uploads and 'Recently approved PDFs' list, Study Buddy real PDF summarisation (Exam notes mode), bookmark toggle + shelf + removal, admin exam schedule create + student countdown + delete, authorization block on /admin/pdfs and /admin/colleges for a student, and 390px mobile responsiveness across /register, /dashboard, /dashboard/uploads/new, /bookmarks and /admin/pdfs. Every flow passed after a minor test-data adjustment (backend rejects re-upload of identical bytes with 'You have already uploaded this exact file' - used a freshly generated PDF to create the pending upload for the rejection scenario).

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking pdf-bookmark-toggle inside the shelf card to un-save an item, the card is not immediately removed from shelf-pdf-list (button flips from 'Saved' to 'Save' but the item remains until the page is re-fetched). A fresh navigation to /bookmarks correctly shows the empty state. Minor UX polish: refetch or filter locally after toggle.

action_items: Optional: on Bookmarks page, after un-bookmarking a PDF from within shelf-pdf-list, remove the card from the list without requiring navigation (local state update or refetch).
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate-upload rejection message ('You have already uploaded this exact file') is a good server-side guard, but the /dashboard/uploads/new form silently keeps the user on the same page with only a small alert. Consider mapping the specific error into an inline field/error toast with clearer copy and a retry hint.
The 'Rejected' status pill only exposes the rejection reason inline (upload-reason-<id>), which is good. Confirm the same reason is echoed via API for future email/notification use.
